A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same SYSU-CMCC benchmark and PIA method, with readable text, equations, tables, and figures. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix. V1 mentions separate supplementary evaluations that are unavailable; their removal or contents cannot be inferred.

before.justification: V1 reports original SYSU-CMCC benchmark comparisons, component ablations, hyperparameter sweeps, and qualitative analyses in Section 5.

after.justification: V2 retains these original experiments and reports an additional CSCI comparison and revised baseline results.

M1.justification: Equation (14) adds L_base to the stated Stage-I objective, also affecting Stage II through L_I. This is a limited objective revision, but L_base is undefined, so its implementation and whether training actually changed remain unclear. The DBDL and BPL procedures otherwise remain intact.

E1.justification: The supplied experimental results remain on SYSU-CMCC under V2I and I2V retrieval. V2's dataset-statistics table does not establish evaluation on additional datasets. Removing v1's reference to unavailable supplementary evaluations does not establish that benchmark coverage was removed.

E2.justification: The main comparison adds CSCI, cited as Colors See Colors Ignore, in v2 Table 2. All comparators from v1 Table 1 remain, including DEEN and AIM; their changed scores are result changes rather than new comparison methods.

E3.justification: Reported metrics, retrieval directions, ResNet-50 backbone, image size, augmentation, 90-epoch budget, Stage-II timing, and batch composition remain unchanged. V2 omits the train/test split counts without specifying a replacement split, which reduces documentation but does not establish a changed protocol.

E4.justification: The six component-ablation configurations and results match between v1 Table 2 and v2 Table 3. Hyperparameter sweeps, retrieval examples, distance distributions, and attention-map analyses are retained. The corrected progressive-learning discussion interprets existing evidence rather than adding an experiment.

E5.justification: Neither PDF reports repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, significance tests, or experimental uncertainty estimates. V2's dataset-statistics table does not introduce uncertainty reporting.

E6.justification: Between v1 Table 1 and v2 Table 2, DEEN's V2I Rank-1/mAP changes from 21.7/22.6 to 28.3/24.8, while AIM's changes from 41.2/34.8 to 37.7/28.8; their I2V scores also change. CSCI results are added. PIA remains at 57.0/46.5 for V2I and 50.4/50.3 for I2V. The baseline revisions are unexplained, so they should not be interpreted as demonstrated same-setting improvements or deterioration.

T1.justification: Equation (14)'s mathematical definition of the training objective gains L_base, a substantive formula revision rather than equivalent notation. No theorem, proof, or formal guarantee is added. Equation (4)'s explicit classifier parameters are explanatory notation.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims: introducing CMCC-ReID and its first benchmark, proposing progressive DBDL/BPL learning, and outperforming existing methods. These claims are not narrowed despite the new related-work discussion.

C2.justification: Section 5.3 corrects the progressive-learning discussion from comparing Index-6 with Index-5 to comparing Index-6 with Index-3. It now explains that adding BPL without progressive learning can produce marginal gains or degradation, consistent with the unchanged table. Other mechanism explanations and applicability claims remain essentially unchanged.

D1.justification: V2 adds a repository link, identifies matching source-camera images as identity anchors, and explains camera-specific verification and filtering in Section 3 and Figure 3. However, it removes v1's training split of 141 identities/12,141 images and test split of 73 identities/6,234 images. The link alone does not establish resource availability.

R1.justification: V2 adds six cited works, including CSCI and Wei et al.'s visible-infrared clothes-changing dataset study. Section 2.1 newly distinguishes PIA from that closely related study through systematic treatment of coupled clothing/modality variation and progressive learning. The broader positioning remains unchanged; BiT's publication update is not a new cited work.

P1.justification: V2 rewrites the dataset-construction passage, numbers the two related-work subsections, clarifies pooling and classifier notation, and corrects the ablation discussion. It also adds affiliation/funding details and removes the supplementary-results pointer. Most prose and the overall section sequence are retained.

P2.justification: V2 adds a dataset-verification diagram and a dataset-statistics table, expands and reorders the main comparison table, and adjusts existing figure captions and panel labels. Existing method and analysis figures are retained with renumbering and relocation rather than replaced by new evidence.

improvement.justification: V2 improves dataset-construction transparency, adds a relevant comparator and prior-work discussion, and corrects the ablation interpretation. However, it removes essential split information and introduces an undefined L_base term, weakening reproducibility of the stated objective. These opposing changes, together with unexplained baseline-score revisions, prevent a confident net-quality judgment from the supplied PDFs.
